newsitem.title: USA: Brite Voice launches calling card service.
newsitem.headline: Brite Voice launches calling card service.

text.p: Brite Voice Systems Inc said Wednesday it is launching a new calling card service that provides several special features like speech-activated dialing and voice and fax mail.
Brite users of its Preferred Card may also access a national telephone directory and use a "find me" service that locates them at any telephone number provided by the user.
The Preferred Card will be available through provate label and co-branding partnerships with retailers, financial institutions, and media and telephone companies, Brite said.
Brite develops and provides telecommunications technology.
Its shares were off 3/8 Wednesday at 9-5/8.
